### 🎙️ The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge  
**Guest: Frances Vincen-Brown**  
**Episode Title:** The Science and Spirit of Holistic Aesthetics  

---

**Bethany Gifford (00:02)**  
Hi everyone and welcome back to *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge.*  
I’m your host, **Bethany Gifford**, founder of *New Era Intel,* where we help medical spas, wellness clinics, and aesthetic leaders scale smarter through data, strategy, and authenticity.  

Today’s guest brings an incredible blend of science, energy, and soul to the world of aesthetics. She’s an esthetician, Reiki Master Teacher, herbalist, and educator who has spent more than two decades helping clients heal from the inside out.  

I’m thrilled to welcome **Frances Vincen-Brown**, founder of a holistic wellness practice in Boise, Idaho — where she and her husband have been transforming lives for over 20 years through integrative skin health, energy work, and mindful care.  

---

**Bethany (00:45)**  
Frances has such a unique approach to beauty and wellness. She doesn’t see them as separate worlds — she sees them as one. With a background in Ayurvedic, Chinese, and Western herbalism, she formulates her own skincare line using organic, clean ingredients, driven by her own health journey with allergies and autoimmune sensitivities.  

For Frances, *skin health is cellular health.* She focuses on mitochondrial repair, inflammation, and emotional balance, proving that true radiance comes from the inside.  

---

**Bethany (01:15)**  
In our conversation, we talk about her philosophy of “whole-being aesthetics” — how emotional energy, spiritual wellness, and science-based therapies all work together.  

She shares the modalities that define her practice, from **PEMF therapy** and **red light therapy** to **sound healing** and **Reiki**. These are not just holistic add-ons — they’re backed by research and results, combining NASA-developed technology with ancient energetic principles to restore balance at a cellular level.  

---

**Bethany (01:50)**  
Frances also opens up about her upcoming continuing education course for estheticians: **“Zombie Cells & Skin Health.”** This course explores senescent cells, the biology of aging, and how practitioners can integrate holistic science into real aesthetic protocols.  

It’s built on over forty-eight scientific studies and challenges the misconception that “natural” means “not scientific.” Her work proves that the future of aesthetics lies in merging ancient wisdom with modern research.  

---

**Bethany (02:25)**  
What I love most about Frances is her heart. She and her husband have built their business entirely through word of mouth — with some clients staying with them for nearly twenty years. Their success isn’t driven by marketing, but by genuine connection, care, and emotional intelligence.  

Through years of work, she’s seen firsthand how emotions show up in the skin — how stress, trauma, and energy can physically manifest — and how touch, empathy, and presence can help clients heal more deeply than any topical ever could.  

---

**Bethany (02:55)**  
Frances is living proof that you can build a sustainable, soulful business by staying true to your values and honoring the whole person — mind, body, and spirit.  

Her journey shows that beauty isn’t just about correction or surface change. It’s about energy, connection, and choosing to see skin as a reflection of what’s happening within.  

---

**Bethany (03:20)**  
Frances, thank you for sharing your wisdom, your warmth, and your passion for integrated wellness. It’s voices like yours that remind us that the future of aesthetics isn’t just technical — it’s deeply human.  

For those who want to connect with Frances or learn about her upcoming course, check the show notes below for her links and updates.  

I’m your host, **Bethany Gifford**, and this is *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge.*  
If this episode inspired you, be sure to like, subscribe, and share — and I’ll see you next time. 💚  

---

Here’s your **podcast script** version of the Frances Vincen-Brown guest primer — written in your usual *Aesthetic & Wellness Edge* style:  

---

## 🎙️ Podcast Script – *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*  
**Guest: Frances Vincen-Brown**  
**Episode Theme: Integrating Energy, Science & Soul in Aesthetics**

---

**Bethany Gifford (00:00)**  
Hi everyone and welcome back to *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge!* I’m your host, Bethany Gifford — founder of *New Era Intel*, where we help aesthetic and wellness professionals scale smarter and more sustainably.  

Today’s guest is someone who perfectly embodies the bridge between science, spirituality, and beauty. She’s an esthetician, Reiki Master Teacher, herbalist, and wellness educator with over two decades of experience helping clients heal from the inside out. Please welcome **Frances Vincen-Brown**, founder of a holistic wellness practice in Boise, Idaho.  

---

**Bethany (00:45)**  
Frances, I’m so happy to have you here. I love your story because it’s such a beautiful example of what happens when we stop treating aesthetics and wellness as separate industries and start seeing them as one whole ecosystem.  

---

**Frances Vincen-Brown (00:57)**  
Thank you, Bethany! I’m excited to be here. For me, it’s always been connected — mind, body, and spirit. I’ve been an esthetician for 17 years and a Reiki Master Teacher for over 20. My husband and I have run our wellness practice together for more than two decades. He’s a massage therapist, and we’ve always believed that touch, energy, and care are all part of true healing.  

---

**Bethany (01:30)**  
I love that. And what’s so unique about you is that you were integrating modalities like Reiki, sound therapy, and PEMF long before it became popular. You were “integrative aesthetics” before it even had a name.  

Tell me a bit about what inspired that approach — was it personal experience or something you observed in your clients?  

---

**Frances (01:55)**  
A little of both. I’ve had my own health challenges — allergies, autoimmune issues — so I started studying Ayurvedic, Chinese, and Western herbs about 20 years ago. That led me to formulate my own organic skincare line using ingredients that are 70 to 100 percent organic. I believe skin health starts at the cellular level — mitochondrial health — not just at the surface.  

---

**Bethany (02:25)**  
That’s such a powerful statement: *skin health is cellular health.* I think the industry is finally catching up to that idea.  

You’re also working on a continuing-education course about senescent cells, or “zombie cells,” and how they affect the skin. Can you share what inspired that and what professionals can expect from it?  

---

**Frances (02:45)**  
Yes! I wanted to bring science to holistic aesthetics. There’s a misconception that “natural” means “not scientific.” My course includes 48 peer-reviewed studies showing how certain modalities and ingredients can help manage cellular aging. I want practitioners to understand *why* these things work — PEMF, red light, herbal actives — so they can speak with confidence and credibility.  

---

**Bethany (03:20)**  
That’s amazing. I think one of the most exciting shifts we’re seeing is practitioners like you leading with evidence while staying true to the heart-centered side of wellness.  

You’ve built such a loyal client base over 20 years. You and your husband have clients who’ve been with you since the beginning. What do you think has allowed you to sustain that kind of longevity?  

---

**Frances (03:45)**  
It’s connection. Our clients aren’t just customers — they’ve become friends, confidants, family. When you’re touching people and working with their energy, you’re helping them release emotions, not just treat their skin. We truly care, and people feel that. We’ve never advertised; everything has been word-of-mouth.  

---

**Bethany (04:15)**  
That’s beautiful. And it’s something our listeners — especially business owners — really need to hear: you can build a profitable, sustainable practice by leading with authenticity and care.  

You mentioned PEMF and red light therapy earlier, and those are two modalities I’m fascinated with. Can you explain how you incorporate them into your treatments and what results you’ve seen?  

---

**Frances (04:40)**  
Absolutely. Both PEMF and red light therapy are NASA-backed technologies that stimulate cellular repair and energy production. They help calm inflammation, boost circulation, and improve skin texture. When combined with Reiki or massage, they support emotional and energetic balance too — it’s truly whole-body healing.  

---

**Bethany (05:05)**  
I love how you describe that synergy. You’re showing that modern science and ancient modalities can coexist beautifully.  

As we wrap up, I’d love to know what’s next for you — any new launches, courses, or upcoming collaborations?  

---

**Frances (05:25)**  
Yes! I’m finishing my *Zombie Cells & Skin Health* course for NCEA continuing ed credit, and I’m working on expanding our holistic education side. Now that my kids are grown and I’m helping raise my grandkids, it feels like the perfect time to do something that’s just for me — to give back and help others grow in this field.  

---

**Bethany (05:55)**  
That’s incredible, Frances. You’re such an inspiration — bridging the gap between wellness, science, and spirituality. Thank you for sharing your wisdom with us today.  

Before we sign off, where can listeners connect with you or learn more about your practice and upcoming course?  

---

**Frances (06:10)**  
They can find me on Instagram and Facebook under **Frances Vincen-Brown**, or visit our practice in Boise. We’ll have updates on the course launch there soon!  

---

**Bethany (06:25)**  
Perfect. We’ll include all those links in the show notes so listeners can reach you directly.  

Frances, thank you again for joining me. And to everyone listening — if this conversation resonated with you, don’t forget to like, subscribe, and share *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*.  

I’m your host, **Bethany Gifford**, and I’ll see you next week with another inspiring guest redefining what wellness and beauty can truly mean. 💚  

---
